stockScan.lotNotOnScreen: This batch is not available here. Check the stock on hand and the expiry date, or enter this item manually.
stockScan.lotNotYetCreatable: This batch is not in the system yet. Add it manually before scanning it.
stockScan.lotRequired: This product is tracked by batch, but the barcode carries no batch number. Enter this item manually.
stockScan.productAmbiguous: This barcode matches more than one product on this screen. Select the product manually.
stockScan.productNotOnScreen: This product is not available on this screen. Check that it is in this program and has stock on hand.
